items.title: A Routing Bug Took Solana 86% of the Way to Losing Finality
items.whyYouShouldCare: The routing bug that nearly compromised Solana's finality highlights vulnerabilities that could impact network reliability and user confidence.

items.title: Smart contract blockchain Solana nearly froze Wednesday, Marinade Finance says
items.whyYouShouldCare: The near-freeze of Solana raises concerns about the stability of its smart contract capabilities, which could deter developers and users from engaging with the ecosystem.

items.title: MoneyGram backs Solana – Can rising DeFi liquidity power SOL’s Q3 rally?
items.whyYouShouldCare: MoneyGram's support for Solana could enhance liquidity in DeFi, potentially driving demand for SOL and boosting its market performance in Q3.
